verdict.rationale: Instinct is described as trained to use a computer and to sign into third-party accounts with your credentials to book and buy on your behalf. Testers report it finding cheap flights, booking travel, ordering, and purchasing, and they note sites treat it like a scraper and bot-block it on airline and card sites, which implies it acts on live websites. Hands-on reports also show real limits: slower than a rival and blocked more often, wrong bookings that led to fees, and a frozen card during a purchase. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a browser-operating capability, reliable task completion without bot-blocking or errors, and independent demonstration of open-ended web research.
